blockingIssues.description: Composer Retry is functionally broken: retryLastPrompt sets draft then calls sendMessage() without an explicit message, while sendMessage reads stale stateRef.current.draft, causing Retry to no-op when draft is empty.
SettingsPage.tsx is a wrapper around legacy settings.js instead of a React-native migration, so the feature does not satisfy the requested migration objective.
Sandbox status rendering is incorrectly gated by status.provider even though backend status payload has no provider field; container metadata/running badge view is suppressed on real responses.
Sandbox image normalization expects repo/size_mb while backend returns repository/size, causing image table metadata to render as unknown/empty against real API responses.
Legacy artifact internal/channels/dashboard/ui/app.js remains after legacy removal scope, and it imports deleted src/main.js.
Legacy stylesheet internal/channels/dashboard/ui/styles.css remains even though removal scope called for old styles.css cleanup after Tailwind migration.

suggestedGuidanceUpdates.suggestion: Reconcile validation guidance by explicitly allowing scoped Playwright specs for in-progress migration milestones when full-suite failures are known and unrelated.
suggestedGuidanceUpdates.evidence: Repeated across react-migrate-chat, react-migrate-runs, react-migrate-sessions, react-migrate-scheduler, and react-migrate-dashboards review reports; mission AGENTS.md already documents scoped-spec expectation.

suggestedGuidanceUpdates.suggestion: Add a required API-contract parity check step for mocked Playwright routes (verify mock response shapes against backend structs/endpoints before finalizing).
suggestedGuidanceUpdates.evidence: react-migrate-sandbox passed mocked tests while shipping blocking schema mismatches (provider/repo/size_mb vs real status/image payload fields).

suggestedGuidanceUpdates.suggestion: Define explicit migration completion criteria that prohibit legacy-wrapper implementations for page-migration features.
suggestedGuidanceUpdates.evidence: react-migrate-settings was marked completed despite SettingsPage.tsx delegating core UI to legacy settings.js.

suggestedGuidanceUpdates.suggestion: Keep feature source references and expectedBehavior lists current and complete (avoid stale legacy file paths; include all critical controls called out in descriptions).
suggestedGuidanceUpdates.evidence: Stale references to removed runs.js/sessions.js/agent_monitor.js and missing explicit Retry expectation in react-migrate-chat expectedBehavior.

suggestedGuidanceUpdates.suggestion: Add an explicit exception path for deletion-heavy/cutover features where implementation-first then test realignment is the safer order.
suggestedGuidanceUpdates.evidence: react-remove-legacy handoff recorded justified procedure deviation for strict test-first sequencing.

suggestedGuidanceUpdates.suggestion: Add a bootstrap command entry for .factory/init.sh and refresh stale Playwright helper command references to removed .spec.js files.
suggestedGuidanceUpdates.evidence: Monitor/scheduler transcripts use init.sh but it is absent from command shortcuts; services.yaml still references tests/e2e/shared-components.spec.js while only .spec.ts exists.

rejectedObservations.observation: Multiple duplicated reports of the same frontend-worker full-suite-vs-scoped-spec mismatch.
Multiple duplicated reports of stale legacy source-path references in migration feature metadata.
Repeated missing-init-command notes from monitor/scheduler reviews.
